Maria — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the highlighted rows. Below is a concise summary you can drop into the SIG IR section; I also attached our customer incident-notice template and a link to the internal playbook.

High-level breach-notice routing and timelines (standard):
- Initial triage acknowledgement: within 1 hour of detection for incidents impacting customer data or availability.
- Customer-facing acknowledgement: best-effort within 24 hours if we have confirmed customer impact.
- Full substantive customer notice: within 72 hours of confirmation for incidents involving customer data (subject to legal review).
- Regulator escalation: we follow contractual/regulatory obligations; for GDPR-impacting incidents we route to Legal immediately and aim for notification within 72 hours as required.

Primary POCs (initial routing):
- Security ops: Jonas Weber — Security Incident Lead
- Legal/compliance: Neha Kapoor — Counsel, Privacy & Security
- Customer success / account ops: Markus Klein — Escalation PO C
- Executive escalation: Aditya Rao (CTO office) if incident meets SLA/contract escalation thresholds

Evidence artifacts we provide on request (typical):
- Incident timeline and triage notes (redacted as needed)
- Relevant service logs and request traces for affected windows
- Count of affected customer records (as determinable)
- Notification templates and communication history

Contract exceptions: Some enterprise contracts include accelerated notice requirements (e.g., 48h). If GreenFintech has a contractual clause requiring 48h, please flag the contract and we will route the playbook to prioritize that SLA and notify Legal immediately.

Next steps / ask:
1) Confirm whether GreenFintech has a 48-hour contractual requirement or other regulator-mandated window.
2) We'll populate the SIG IR section with the summary above and attach our incident-notice-template.docx.
3) If you want a patch-up call, I can schedule 30 minutes with Jonas and Neha tomorrow.

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-incident-playbooks (incident playbook, access shared)
Attachments: incident-notice-template.docx

Best,

Quick legal guidance to include in the SIG reply:

- For EU/EEA customers where personal data is implicated, Redwood follows GDPR timelines and aims for notification within 72 hours of becoming aware, subject to investigatory constraints.
- For US customers, contractual terms prevail; some contracts (especially in finance/healthcare) require accelerated notice (48 hours).
- We will not publish specific intranet logs publicly but will provide redacted timelines and counts to the contracting customer and auditors under NDA.

Action items for us:
